title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must identify that the reason for ignoring the electrostatic force is due to the bodies being electrically neutral.

title: Understanding of Neutrality
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain that both the Earth and the Moon are electrically neutral, which eliminates electrostatic forces.

title: Clarification of Forces
description: Important Criteria: The student should differentiate between gravitational and electrostatic forces in their reasoning.

title: Misinterpretation of Effects
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid incorrectly attributing the lack of electrostatic force to tidal effects or other unrelated phenomena.

title: Alternative Explanations
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention that the electrostatic force is negligible compared to gravitational force as an additional point.
